policies.title: Australian ordinary passports: specified visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Current Smartraveller guidance expressly establishes visa-free visitor access for these destinations.
conditions: XK: tourist stay under 90 days in 180; UA: up to 90 days in 180, but airspace and borders remain operationally constrained; TN: 90 days or less; PA: air or land arrival, initial 90 days; BA: up to 90 days in six months.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, health, carrier and final-admission conditions are outside this classification.

policies.title: Australian ordinary passports: explicitly electronic visitor visas
policies.summary: Current Australian guidance or a destination-controlled official service establishes electronic visitor-visa issuance for these ordinary passports.
conditions: IQ: federal Iraq electronic visa is required before travel; Kurdistan has a separate regional route. CU: Cuba's online tourist visa replaces the Tourist Card.
All routes remain subject to passport, purpose, entry-point, security, health and final-admission conditions.

policies.title: Australian ordinary passports: specified tourist visas on arrival
policies.summary: Current guidance expressly makes an arrival-issued tourist visa available to Australian ordinary-passport visitors.
conditions: BD: Bangladesh's mission guidance names Australian nationals for the conditional tourism visa-on-arrival route, normally a maximum 30-day single entry; officer satisfaction and supporting-document requirements apply.
KH: tourist visas on arrival are valid for 30 days; the e-visa is an alternative route, not a reason to classify the visitor baseline as electronic-only.

policies.title: Australian ordinary passports: expressly pre-departure visas
policies.summary: Smartraveller expressly requires these visas before arrival or travel.
conditions: TM also requires a letter of invitation, even for transit. TD and NE require a visa before arrival/travel.
This does not normalize work, residence, special documents, entry-point, security or final-admission requirements.
